publishedRecipe.name: Asian-Style Pork Soup with Napa Cabbage, Potatoes, Carrots & Mushrooms

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 medium yellow potatoes
2 medium carrots
1 lb cremini mushrooms
1 medium head napa cabbage

instructions.primary_message: Medium dice potatoes. Place in a medium bowl.
Peel, trim, and small dice carrots. Add to the bowl with the potatoes.
Thinly slice mushrooms. Add to the bowl.
Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
While the pot heats up, peel, halve, and small dice onion; peel and mince garlic. Add both to the bowl and set aside.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add pork and spices; cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 4-5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
4 tsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ lb lean ground pork
1 tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper
½ tsp coriander, ground

instructions.primary_message: Add veggies to the pot. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until slightly softened, 3-4 minutes more.
Meanwhile, trim off and discard root end of cabbage; halve lengthwise, then slice crosswise into 1-inch wide strips.

When the veggies are done, add cabbage, broth, soy sauce, and chili-garlic sauce to the pot; stir to combine the soup, then bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, reduce heat to low and simmer, stirring occasionally, until veggies are tender, 12-15 minutes. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
64 fl oz (8 cups) chicken or vegetable broth
¼ cup soy sauce
2 tsp chili-garlic sauce

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide soup between bowls and enjoy!
